xꜭol: xk'ol — it lay, was there (inferred); x- completive + k'ol, taken as a form of k'o 'be there' that says where a thing lies; verb
xin: xin — I (did); x- completive + in 'I', before an intransitive verb
chichu: chichu — lady, mother (inferred); a respectful word for an older woman, after Brasseur ('ma dame et mère') and chuch 'mother'; noun of address
alib: alib' — daughter-in-law; the tie between a woman and her son's wife, said from either side (inferred); noun
alcual: alk'wal — child, children; al (a woman's child) + k'ajol (a man's son) made one word, as in ralcualah; noun
quetal: ketal — their sign, their trace; ki- 'their' (qu- before a vowel) + etal 'sign, trace'; possessed noun
ꜩihel: tzijel — word (inferred); tzij 'word' + -el, in ki tzijel 'their word'; noun
xꜭo: xk'o — (uncertain) x- + k'o 'there is'; doubtful division, not understood
vcatbal: ukatb'al — (doubtful) its judgment, sentence (guess); u- 'its' + a root and -b'al, perhaps q'at 'cut, judge' with Brasseur's letter, but the manuscript has plain c; not otherwise known; noun
valib: walib' — my daughter-in-law; w- 'my' + alib'; possessed noun
cacal: kakal — angry (guess, after Brasseur 'en colère'); not otherwise known; letters respelled
zibanic: sib'anik — painting, writing; verbal noun in -ik, of one root with ahꜩibenai 'painter, writer'; plain z in the manuscript, respelled s
cotonic: kotonik — carving; verbal noun in -ik, of one root with ahcot 'carver'
hutaquih: jutaq'ij — every day, each day (inferred); hutac 'each' + q'ij 'day' written as one word
cubul: kub'ul — seated, at rest (inferred); kub' 'sit' + -ul, the ending of a position; stative
uah: waj — want (inferred); w- 'I' (written u before a vowel) + aj 'want', as in ca uah 'I want it'; verb
ibare: ibare — meaning not known; left unrendered; respelled letter for letter
vhat: ujat — (doubtful) go (guess); perhaps ja 'go' + at 'you' with an unexplained u-, after Brasseur's 'Va donc'; letters respelled
quecha: kecha — their food; ki- 'their' (qu- before a vowel) + echa 'food'; possessed noun
veeh: weej — eat (guess); after Brasseur ('ceux qui mangent'); form not clear
hacha: jacha — harvest, gather (inferred); after Brasseur ('moissonne'); verb, of one root with hach
cabix: kab'ix — their field; ki- 'their' (c- before a vowel) + ab'ix · qab'ix — our field; qa- 'our' + ab'ix, the same letters
hocam: jokam — cleared, opened (guess, after Brasseur 'ouvert et nettoyé'); not otherwise known; letters respelled
huvi: juwi' — one head, one plant; jun 'one' + wi' 'head, top' (as in chuvi 'on top of'); noun phrase
chivi: chiwi — any more, at all (inferred); chi 'any more' + wi' written as one word
vcavi: ukawi' — its second head; u- 'its' + ka- 'two' (as in caib) + wi' 'head'
roxvi: roxwi' — its third head; r- 'its' + ox 'three' + wi' 'head'
vachelaam: wachelaam — bore fruit (guess); built on wach 'face, fruit'; not otherwise known; letters respelled, the double vowel kept
quila: kila — alas (guess); a cry, not otherwise known; letters respelled
macol: makol — sinner; mac 'sin' + -ol, the agent ending; noun
ꜭazbol: k'asb'ol — debtor (guess); k'az 'debt' + -b'ol; not the k'as 'live' of ꜭazlic; noun
echa: echa — food; noun (vecha 'my food', quecha 'their food')
vziquixic: usik'ixik — being called upon; u- + sik'ij 'call' + -x (passive) + -ik, as in xziquinic
xtoh: Xtoj — Xtoh, one of three names Xquic calls on; Brasseur takes it as x- (ix) + toj, a day name, 'rain', a goddess of food (inferred); kept as a name
xcanil: Xkanil — Xcanil, one of three names Xquic calls on; Brasseur takes it as x- + ganil from gan 'yellow, ripeness', a goddess of harvest (inferred); kept as a name
xcacau: Xkakaw — Xcacau, one of three names Xquic calls on; Brasseur takes it as x- + cacau 'cacao' (inferred); kept as a name
ꜩiya: tziya — (inferred) prepare maize with ash; after Brasseur's note ('préparer le maïs avec la cendre'); verb
queꜭha: kech'a — their food; the same word as quecha, written with ꜭh; ki- 'their' + echa
zamiy: samiy — silk of the maize ear (inferred, after Brasseur 'les barbes'); noun, plain z in the manuscript
boc: b'ok — pull up (guess, after Brasseur 'arracha doucement'); not otherwise known; verb
hach: jach — harvest, pick (inferred); after Brasseur ('sans déraciner'); verb, the root of jacha
cau: kaw — (guess) lay, arrange, after Brasseur's rendering 'arrangea'; not otherwise known
xcaxinic: xkaxinik — it was filled (guess, after Brasseur); x- completive + a root not known + -ik; letters respelled
xecan: xekan — they carried a load (inferred); x- completive + e 'they' + ecan 'carry a load'; the toggle keeps k
recan: rekan — her load, her burden; r- 'her' + ecan 'load'; possessed noun
auumal: awumal — by you (inferred, doubtful reading); a- 'you' + umal, as in rumal 'by him', with w before the vowel
calaba: kalab'a — (guess) lay waste, ruin; after Brasseur 'ruiné', doubtful letters; letters respelled
rila: rila — she sees it; r- 'she, her' (the form before a vowel) + il 'see' + -a; verb
vcolibal: ukolib'al — its lying-place (inferred); u- 'its' + col + -ib'al, the ending of place, after Brasseur 'l'endroit où avait été placé'; noun
nauinac: nawinaq — wise, those who have come to know (inferred); nao 'know' + -inaq, the state reached; stative
